Meet Sebastian

Every participant is different. Every support relationship should be too.

I'm Sebastian — a Newcastle local currently completing my 4th year studies in psychology, and I'm the person you'll actually be working with, not a rotating roster of unfamiliar faces. I started General Disability Support because participants deserve consistency, genuine understanding and someone who follows through.

Fully checked and insured — National Police Check, NDIS Worker Screening Check and current First Aid/CPR — supporting people across Newcastle, Lake Macquarie and the Hunter.

Disability support should create independence — not dependence.

Checks & Compliance

Referral & Request Form

Submit a referral without leaving the website.

Use this form for a Disability Support referral, or a general enquiry. A short message is enough to start the conversation.

For privacy, avoid including highly sensitive medical information in the first message. We can follow up securely if more detail is required.
